origin/claude/busy-newton-bb37wv had gone unmerged since 2026-09-25. Merged into main, resolving an add/add conflict against a competing ShankpitLeaderboardHandler main had grown independently in the meantime (both would have registered the same mux path, panicking at startup). Kept busy-newton's implementation (has real test coverage), removed main's duplicate handler + duplicate route registration. go build/vet/test ./... all clean. Commit cbe02ea.

⚓ ☃
title: Merged abandoned SHANKPIT leaderboard branch (busy-newton)
